site.audience: general consumers seeking premium technology products

brief.title: Orchard — The Best Way to Buy the Products You Love
brief.one_liner: A premium technology brand's official online store offering the latest devices, accessories, financing options, and personalized shopping experiences.
brief.goal: Provide a seamless, visually clean shopping experience that showcases the latest product lineup, offers multiple ways to save, and guides customers through purchase decisions with specialist support and trade-in programs.

pages.objective: Brand landing page showcasing flagship products with hero sections for each major product line, promotional tiles for services like trade-in and financing, and an entertainment content carousel.

Main online store page presenting the full product catalog in horizontal carousels, specialist help options, store differentiators, accessories, audio products, brand collaborations, services, and savings programs.

Category page for laptop and desktop computers, displaying all models with pricing and financing, comparison guides, trade-in and financing options, accessories, setup support, and special store links.
Category page for tablets, displaying all tablet models with pricing and financing, comparison guides, trade-in options, accessories, setup support, and special store links.
